command.untrustValidationExecutable: Disallow ansible-lint validation executable (defined as workspace setting)
configuration.runner.workingDirectory: Working directory for ansible-playbook and ansible-navigator runner commands. Relative paths are resolved from the selected playbook’s workspace folder. Supports ${workspaceFolder} and ${workspaceFolder:name}. Leave empty to keep the default terminal working directory. The directory must exist.
configuration.suggest.basic: Controls whether the built-in Ansible language suggestions are enabled. The support suggests Ansible globals and variables.
configuration.title: Ansible
configuration.validate.run: Whether the linter is run on save or on type.
description: Community fork of vscode-ansible with portable runner working directory and Run Playbook CodeLens.
